scores.visual_critic_note: Ambitious multi-layout tech demo with clean card chrome and depth-based opacity, but the 900px SVG overflows the viewport in the screenshot (cropping the circle pack), Tableau10 shuffled colors are preset not designed, and the heavy dark-teal edge bundles (#476376) visually compete with the hierarchical fills rather than receding behind them.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is correct (scaleSqrt for force-layout circles), domains are data-driven (d3.extent), key functions present on both node and link joins; sunburst applies a sqrt y-scale mapping [0,r]→[0,r] that compresses inner rings but is a presentational choice rather than data deception.
scores.stress_test_note: Easing param sliders fire updateLayout() on every input event launching a fresh 1500ms transition per pixel of drag; no .interrupt() guard before new transitions allows mid-flight snaps; the force-layout drag handler has no touch/mouse event filtering.
scores.cognitive_load_note: The 8-layout morphing explorer is a single conceptual unit (good for working memory) and the 10-color palette reads cleanly on the hierarchy circles, but the default Circle Pack view stacks 300 cross-links at 92% bundle tension, collapsing them into a dense hairball at the root that makes connection structure completely opaque until the click-to-highlight interaction is used.

proposer: 800 lines, down from 818 (-18 lines). The changes compress three functions (`generateHierarchy`, `generateConnections`, `countFrames`) and `updateEasingControls` by removing intermediate variables, inlining trivial helpers, and tightening loop bodies — all without changing behavior or visual output.
